description: Source code for Slack import and message processing in Mattermost, including functions for importing Slack data, processing Slack message text and attachments, expanding announcements, and replacing user IDs with usernames.

classes.name: Actions
classes.description: Struct holding callback functions for Slack import actions

methods.name: SlackImport
methods.description: Handles importing Slack data, determines admin status, and initiates the import process

methods.name: ProcessSlackText
methods.description: Expands Slack-specific announcements and replaces user IDs with usernames in message text

methods.name: ProcessMessageAttachments
methods.description: Processes message attachments to expand announcements and replace user IDs

methods.name: expandAnnouncement
methods.description: Replaces Slack announcement tags with Mattermost equivalents

methods.name: replaceUserIds
methods.description: Replaces Slack user ID mentions with usernames for Slack compatibility
